verticalRule: For every (x,z) in playableRowSpans, playable applies to all Y without lower or upper limit.
method: Largest 8-neighbor connected component plus the detached Z=270 bottom run identifies the photographed outer contour. Four single-cell gaps on that run are treated as boundary (not actual saved blocks), per user instruction. Four-neighbor flood fill of the contour complement determines the enclosed columns. Disconnected same-ID markers are recorded separately.
limits: Snapshot of the saved world, not a live monitor; new edits to boundary markers require rescanning. Virtual bridges are part of the user-defined perimeter, not saved blocks.
